title.narrative: Urban Water Supply and Sanitation (Sector) Project

description.narrative: ADB has supported the government in improving water supply and sanitation services in 70 of the 176 small towns in Nepal through three small towns projects introducing continuous water supply, meeting national quality standards, and providing universal household connections with subsidized connections and affordable supply for poor and vulnerable households.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3711: 88% of contracts awarded and 82% disbursed as of 09 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: 24 water supply and sanitation subprojects (20 water supply, 2 storm water drainage/fecal sludge management, and 2 DEWATS & Sewerage packages) are planned for the project. Out of these 20 water supply contracts, 15 have already started operation and about 232,966 are already benefitting from the improved water supply services. Similarly, installation of SCADA in five small towns is under implementation. Water tariffs are agreed with the water users and sanitation committees and will be implemented once endorsed by the concerned local governments. Similarly, one fecal sludge management contract is completed, and drainage and wastewater management contracts are under implementation.
Overall physical progress of the project (as of 31 December 2024) is 92% against an elapsed time of 95%. The project also supports the strengthening institutional and community capacities including mainstreaming gender equality and social inclusion in the project activities, and has a provision to support the poor and vulnerable (including women headed households) people of the project municipalities. This includes subsidized piped water supply connection and output-based aid provision for sanitation infrastructure. The project is on track to achieve the outcome level targets and indicators.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/35173/35173-015-apfs-en_10.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/35173/35173-015-iee-en_28.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Apr 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/35173/35173-015-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jul 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/35173/35173-015-sddr-en_28.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/35173/35173-015-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: WASH Plans for all project local bodies will be integrated with recently developed National WASH (N-WASH). Training on NWASH tool completed and data collection is ongoing. The data for remaining part of the municipalities will be collected by DWSSM and municipalities.
19 Climate-Resilient subprojects selected. Seven subprojects have been included in UWSSP implementation. 4 subprojects unfeasible due to low willingness from WUA. Ten subproject's detail/FSR have been received for review.
A second list of 24 towns have been approved from MoWS. 10 are under detail study.
Leadership and GESI in WASH training conducted in all three regions with 105 participants (6 male & 99 female).
109 participants from Eastern, central & western regions, TDF, DWSSM, project municipalities participated in the SMART utility management training (41 Female; 68 Male).
Awareness campaign participated by and reached to 111,942 (50.13 %) females of total 223,314 participants through formal/informal campaigns.
20 WUSCs of registered 20 WUAs formed (out of 20 projects); 20 contracted WSS WUSCs have 39.89 % female members; 20 contracted subproject WUSCs have at least one female member in key position.
Water tariff guideline for TDF and Water Tariff Implementation Guideline for WUSC prepared by TDF. Business plan of 5 from 1st & 2nd phase & 20 from 3rd phase towns prepared. 10 from STWSSSP and 8 from UWSSP are under preparation (the draft is near completion for Charikot, Hupsekot, Liwang and Pragatinagar).
20 water supply contracts in 19 municipalities are awarded and are in various stages of implementation. As of 30 September 2024, a total of 2,521 km pipes are installed or rehabilitated.
Treatment plants designed for all the water supply subprojects are with>0.6 MLD capacity.
20 water supply systems are planned with base year household number as 62,504. So far, 48,727 HHs are connected; 4,801 subsidized connections from 20 contracted subprojects completed.
Ongoing. Design of remaining subprojects are taking in consideration climate and disaster risks.
A total of 3,340 toilets are identified from 20 subprojects. Construction of 3,082 toilets have been completed and are in use. Construction is ongoing for the remaining toilets.
A total 17 proposed from 15 subprojects with 14 completed and 2 under construction.
Two contracts for Charikot and Bhojpur decentralized waste water management system are awarded and in various stages of implementation.
2 storm water drainage contracts in Katahariya and Tikapur subprojects. Both packages are completed with 40.28 km of storm water drainage constructed from 2 packages.
Design of remaining subprojects are taking in consideration climate and disaster risks.
